test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : USO :: LJF : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : USO :: LJF : %

Option 1) # = XVI, % = IZC → XVI : USO :: LJF : IZC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aefa2dfcfb39da7e4bba3dd863e7e38b7e41c781604cb8ae06c14077448a58b4.png] 

Option 2) # = IOR, % = IZC → IOR : USO :: LJF : IZC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a949a9907d382ae54623c12a9b6c5d5dc871200ff83db0ec12160558116b07b.png] 

Option 3) # = XVR, % = IGC → XVR : USO :: LJF : IGC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bec884af8f2df5cd81b3d30b0193439b13e4fb4389525b36bfebdf8c8dd49d69.png] 

Option 4) # = ZOR, % = IQV → ZOR : USO :: LJF : IQV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/831ec372b7657060cee32683e6563c742a1f1316aff7bbe4c5aa6c32869fe859.png] ​

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
